Free Breakfast Workshop

Mastering Inventory Management

Join us for a hands-on breakfast workshop on practical inventory management for growing Kenyan businesses. Network, learn, and enjoy breakfast on us.

📅Friday, 24th July 2026
🕒7:00 AM (EAT)
📍Ndanga Hotel, Ruiru
💰Free

What We'll Cover

  • 🤝

    Networking Breakfast

    Connect with fellow business owners and our team over breakfast before the session starts.

  • 📦

    Stock Control Fundamentals

    Practical methods to track stock levels, reduce waste, and avoid stockouts.

  • 📊

    Reorder Point Planning

    Set smart reorder points so you never run out — or over-order — again.

  • 🧮

    TallyPrime for Inventory

    See how TallyPrime automates stock valuation, batch tracking, and reporting.

  • 🔍

    Audit & Reconciliation Tips

    Simple habits that keep your books and your shelves in sync.

  • 🙋

    Live Q&A

    Bring your inventory challenges — get answers from our certified experts.
